data.name: Realm Revolutions
data.detailed_description:
WISHLIST MY NEW GAME!


Acerca do jogo

Idle game inspired by Swarm Simulator and Realm Grinder. Buy buildings and hire more and more citizens from them. A large number of citizens leads to their discontent. And they may revolt! After the revolution discontent people become happy and give bonus to production.

Production

At the beginning of the game you will have 2 resources: gold and food. Gold is necessary for buying new buildings and for hiring citizens. Food is necessary for the hiring of citizens, while, unlike gold, for each citizen, only one food unit is needed. You need to decide when you are ready to start hiring more expensive citizens, because they require as much food as cheap ones.

Discontent and happines

When there are too many citizens, they become discontent. Discontent citizens can arrange a revolution. After the revolution, discontent citizens will become happy and they will receive a bonus to gold production. The revolutions of citizens are independent, if the revolution was arranged by the peasants, only the peasants will be happy after it. Decide who should start the revolution, because after the revolution the game starts anew!

Further progress

With the construction of new buildings you will discover animals, magic, army and battles with monsters, assimilation of other races and much more.

data.short_description: Earning coins and resources is more fun than ever with this new idle game inspired by Swarm Simulator and Realm Grinder! Buy buildings and hire people, and be ready for a revolution! Your citizens will be very happy if you deal with their discontent, giving you a production bonus!

reviews.review:
Okay, this is far from the first game by the developer I've played, having committed a lot of time to Grim Clicker and DPS idle over the years.  Sadly, while it is also the game I consider having the most potential, it is also the one that I feel lets him down the most. It's one thing to make an idle game purposely slow and all of his games do that a lot, but this one feels very deliberate as a means of getting people to get frustrated and buy the potions and bits you can buy for real money and I find that infuriating. Yes you can make very very slow progress without making purchases, but the pace of progress is so very painfully slow in this one, made worse when a lot of the prestige (revolutions) reset everything, except the one thing you have clicked revolution on. Which means you spend a lot of time going round in a very small circle, not getting very far.

I've put 152 hours into the game, just to try and find out what comes next and honestly I'm finding it simply not worth doing. Even with the game itself being free, I simply consider my time more valuable than to waste it in a futile attempt to see what is around the corner.

It's 8 years since this game had a proper update, which gives me the definite impression, he won't suddenly be coming back offering new content and updates to make anything better.

I mean, even if the game had Steam achievements as a little motivator it would have helped, but nope, no such thing for this game.

So, for me... It's time to uninstall this one, hide it from my Steam, forget about it completely and go back to clicking cookies for my idle fun.
